newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - VOLUMES DIVE IN QUIET MARKET.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - VOLUMES DIVE IN QUIET MARKET.

text.p: Stock Exchange in the week ended December 13, exchange officials
They said volume fell to 66,254 shares valued at 1,236,741
kwacha from 143,506 shares worth 2,035,638 kwacha the previous
Zambia Sugar gained one kwacha to end the week at 12 kwacha
in a traded volume of 18,210 shares worth 200,520 kwacha.
Rothman gained one kwacha to end the week at 33 kwaca and saw
Farmers House remained steady at 220 kwacha and saw 179
shares worth 39,380 kwacha exchanging hands. Chilanga Cement
remained steady at 50 kwacha in a traded volume of 9,547 shares
Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) saw no trades in the
week. Meanwhile, the Zambia Privatisation Trust Fund has
appointed Citibank as the lead merchant bank in the floatation
of Zambia Breweries, exchange officials said.
